title: Navidad Fest 2026 Brings Free Holiday Celebration to Sames Auto Arena on Dec. 1
excerpt: The City of Laredo is kicking off the holiday season with Navidad Fest 2026 on Tuesday, Dec. 1, from 4 to 9 p.m. at Sames Auto Arena — free admission, with the Christmas tree lighting at 7 p.m.
content:
The City of Laredo is kicking off the holiday season with Navidad Fest 2026 on Tuesday, December 1, from 4 to 9 p.m. at Sames Auto Arena. Admission is free.

New this year are a NaviDance Party with a live DJ, glow sticks, festive giveaways and a live camera showing off dancers' best moves; an inflatable obstacle course for young holiday explorers; and Santa's Holiday Crew — an elf, a gingerbread character, a reindeer and even the Grinch — for photos.

Returning favorites include Santa's Workshop craft station, free hot chocolate and cookies, local school performances, a pet holiday fashion show, pictures with Santa, mini train rides and a snow slide.

The Christmas tree lighting ceremony is set for 7 p.m., when the city officially welcomes the holiday season.

Source: City of Laredo — Government, Facebook, November 21, 2026.
